text: Broad 'find .. -name AGENTS.md' stalled in the post workspace; scoped rg-based instruction discovery would have prevented the dead end
tests/cli.rs write_reference_mail assumes its inbox parent already exists; a helper that creates the parent would avoid fixture-only failures
CommandResult lacks Debug, so Result::expect_err cannot be used in send unit tests; a small test helper for extracting AppError would improve test ergonomics

functions.exec returned a PTY session_id, but I mistakenly passed it to functions.wait (which expects an exec cell_id); clearer identifier typing/naming in the tool surface would prevent this dead-end

cargo-modules --acyclic reports inherent type-to-method self cycles even with --no-fns --no-types --no-owns, so it cannot directly verify module-only acyclicity; a module-scope cycle mode would prevent manual edge filtering
